Reason: Identical invoice lines (all 8 fields equal) are data-entry duplicates and add no new purchase.
Cancellations/returns are not purchases; the products were not bought together.
'A' invoices are accounting adjustments ('Adjust bad debt'), not customer orders.

Step: 4. Remove rows with missing product description
Reason: Without a description the item cannot be identified or interpreted.
Zero/negative quantities are stock corrections (e.g. 'damaged', 'lost'), not sales.
Free or negative-price lines are internal adjustments rather than customer purchases.

Step: 7. Remove non-product stock codes (POSTAGE, CARRIAGE, fees, vouchers, ...)
Reason: Postage and fees appear in many baskets for administrative reasons and would create meaningless rules such as {X} -> {POSTAGE}.
Leading/trailing/double spaces and mixed case make the same product look like different items.

Step: 9. Map each StockCode to one canonical description
Reason: Some stock codes have several spellings; the most frequent one is used as the item name.
Whole-word keywords WINE, GIN, CHAMPAGNE, COCKTAIL, BOOZE, ASHTRAY, CIGAR, SPLIFF (alcohol- or smoking-themed items) are excluded; the affected products are listed in excluded_products.csv.

Step: 11. Collapse repeated items within the same invoice
Reason: A basket is a set: buying the same product on two lines is still one item.
